virtualFields.description: Number of published posts in this category.

virtualFields.tsType: { url: string; alt: string | null; source: "chosen" | "cover" | "title_card" | "body_image"; width: number | null; height: number | null } | null
virtualFields.description: The image to use as og:image, ready to use: the share image chosen for this page (cropped to 1200x630 the way it was framed), else the title card Kanorio generates. null when there is none. Same image the hosted site uses. source says where the image came from: chosen (the share image the author picked), cover, title_card (generated by Kanorio from the title) or body_image (the first image in the body). When you use share_image as a thumbnail on a list card, skip title_card: the card already shows the title. width and height are the pixel size url delivers, for og:image:width and og:image:height: 1200x630 for a title card or a cropped image, or the largest box of that shape the image holds when the image (or the part the author framed) is smaller; null for an external URL or an SVG. To resize, pass url to imageUrl, srcSet or kanorioImageLoader from @kanorio/sdk: they keep the author's crop.

virtualFields.tsType: { url: string; alt: string | null; source: "chosen" | "cover" | "title_card" | "body_image"; width: number | null; height: number | null } | null
virtualFields.description: The image to use as og:image, ready to use: the share image the author chose (cropped to 1200x630 the way they framed it), else the cover, else the title card Kanorio generates, else the first image in the body (the watermarked version when the site watermarks article images). null when the post has none. Same image the hosted site uses. alt is the alt text the author wrote for the share image, else the image's own alt text from the media library (none for a title card). source says where the image came from: chosen (the share image the author picked), cover, title_card (generated by Kanorio from the title) or body_image (the first image in the body). When you use share_image as a thumbnail on a list card, skip title_card: the card already shows the title. width and height are the pixel size url delivers, for og:image:width and og:image:height: 1200x630 for a title card or a cropped image, or the largest box of that shape the image holds when the image (or the part the author framed) is smaller; null for an external URL or an SVG. To resize, pass url to imageUrl, srcSet or kanorioImageLoader from @kanorio/sdk: they keep the author's crop.

Semantic HTML: native img/video/iframe tags with srcset and dimensions where known, data-kanorio-asset on Kanorio-hosted media, data-kanorio-lightbox on every image that is not inside a link when the site's blog inline zoom is on (default on), and PDF/file download links (absolute URLs on the Kanorio app host) when the site allows downloads; block wrappers still use kanorio-* classes (cta, faq, table scroll shell).
Plain-text rendering of the article body (for search indexes and excerpts).
